remarks:
More space. More possibilities. More reasons to come take a look! Set on over 1.5 acres at the Four Corners in the Town of Napoli, this spacious country home offers the room, flexibility, & extras that can be hard to find in one property.

Inside, you'll find four bedrooms plus a dedicated office & den, giving you plenty of options for guests, hobbies, a home office, playroom, or additional sleeping space. Two full baths & two half baths add everyday convenience, while the large open kitchen & dining area creates a comfortable gathering place with plenty of room for family & friends. Kitchen appliances are included.

And wait until you see the garage space! In addition to the attached 2-car garage, there's a detached 3-car garage offering exceptional space for vehicles, toys, equipment, storage, or hobbies. One bay has already been transformed into a heated & cooled flex space, currently enjoyed as a workout & movie room—perfect for a game room, studio, workshop, or your own year-round getaway.

Outside is where the country lifestyle really shines. The circular blacktop driveway welcomes you home, while the pond, wide-open lawn, chicken coop, & above-ground pool give you plenty of ways to enjoy the property. A private deck off the primary suite provides direct access to the pool & a peaceful spot for morning coffee or unwinding at the end of the day.

The home features propane hot-water baseboard heat, supplemented by a wood stove in the garage, and offers the space to garden, entertain, play, or simply enjoy having a little breathing room.

Conveniently located within reach of Ellicottville & Holiday Valley Resort, Allegany State Park, Zaepfel Nature Center, Onoville Marina,  & surrounding Southern Tier communities, this property puts recreation and small-town destinations within an easy drive while giving you room to come home & spread out.

If you've been searching for a home with acreage, four bedrooms, flexible living space, five garage bays, a pond, a pool, and room for your hobbies, don't just scroll past this one. Come see how much 10095 Route 242 has to offer—you may be surprised by everything waiting here.
